title: 집에서 보내는 휴가
intro: 설문에서 '집에서 휴가 보내기'를 선택하면 나오는 주제로, 집에서 하는 일 묘사 → 휴가 일과 → 기억에 남는 휴가 경험 → 여행과의 비교 순으로 출제됩니다. 집(housing) 주제의 표현을 그대로 재활용할 수 있어 가성비가 매우 좋습니다. '늦잠 → 커피 → 드라마 → 친구 방문' 같은 나만의 루틴 하나만 확실히 준비하세요.
strategy: 묘사·일과 질문은 하는 일 2~3개를 시간 순서로 말하고, 마지막에 '왜 집이 좋은지' 이유 한 줄을 붙입니다.
경험 질문은 '언제 → 무엇을 했나 → 누가 왔나 → 예상 밖의 일 → 느낌'으로 과거시제 스토리를 만듭니다.
비교 질문은 집 장점 2개, 여행 장점 2개를 대칭으로 말한 뒤 내 선택과 이유로 마무리합니다.

expressions.en: I usually spend my vacation at home because I like to relax.
expressions.ko: 저는 보통 휴가를 집에서 보내는데, 쉬는 게 좋아서요.

expressions.en: I sleep in and have a late breakfast.
I don't have to worry about traffic or crowds.
expressions.ko: 교통 체증이나 사람 많은 것 걱정 안 해도 돼요.

expressions.en: I catch up on dramas and movies I missed.
expressions.note: catch up on = 밀린 것을 따라잡다

expressions.en: Sometimes my friends come over and we order chicken.
expressions.ko: 가끔 친구들이 놀러 와서 같이 치킨을 시켜 먹어요.

expressions.en: It's the best way to recharge after a busy month.
expressions.ko: 바쁜 한 달 뒤에 재충전하기 제일 좋은 방법이에요.

expressions.en: I stay in my pajamas all day and do nothing.
expressions.ko: 하루 종일 잠옷 차림으로 아무것도 안 해요.

expressions.en: Staying home is cheaper than traveling.
expressions.ko: 집에 있는 게 여행보다 돈이 덜 들어요.

expressions.en: The best part about a staycation is that I can do everything at my own pace.
expressions.ko: 집에서 보내는 휴가의 가장 좋은 점은 모든 걸 내 속도대로 할 수 있다는 거예요.
expressions.note: at my own pace = 내 속도대로

expressions.en: I used to travel every summer, but these days I'd rather just stay home.
expressions.ko: 예전엔 여름마다 여행 갔는데, 요즘은 그냥 집에 있는 게 더 좋아요.

expressions.en: I try to do one thing I've been putting off, like cleaning out the closet.
expressions.ko: 미뤄 뒀던 일 하나는 꼭 하려고 해요, 옷장 정리 같은 거요.

expressions.en: Traveling is exciting, but it can be exhausting, too.
By the end of the vacation, I feel completely refreshed.
expressions.ko: 휴가가 끝날 때쯤이면 완전히 충전된 느낌이에요.

expressions.en: Honestly, a few days of doing absolutely nothing is exactly what I need.
expressions.ko: 솔직히 정말 아무것도 안 하는 며칠이 딱 제가 필요한 거예요.

expressions.en: It's not that I don't like traveling; it's just that home is where I truly unwind.
expressions.ko: 여행을 싫어하는 게 아니라, 집이야말로 제가 진짜 긴장을 푸는 곳이라서요.
expressions.note: It's not that ~, it's just that ~

questions.en: You said in the survey that you spend your vacations at home. What do you usually do during a vacation at home, and why do you prefer staying home?
questions.ko: 설문에서 휴가를 집에서 보낸다고 하셨죠. 집에서 휴가를 보낼 때 보통 무엇을 하고, 왜 집에 있는 걸 선호하나요?
tips: 'The best part about ~ is that ~' 로 이유를 강조하세요

answers.IM3: I usually spend my vacation at home. I sleep in and have a late breakfast. Then I watch dramas and movies on Netflix. Sometimes I clean the house or cook something new. In the evening, I have a cup of coffee on the balcony. I prefer staying home because it is cheap and relaxing. I don't have to worry about traffic or crowds. It's the best way to recharge after a busy month.
answers.IH: Well, to be honest, I'm a real homebody, so most of my vacations are staycations. My typical vacation day starts late. I sleep in until nine or ten, make a big breakfast, and take my time with my coffee. After that, I usually catch up on the dramas and movies I missed during the month. Some days I do one thing I've been putting off, like cleaning out the closet or organizing photos. In the evening, I sit on the balcony with a cup of coffee and watch the river. I used to travel every summer, but these days I'd rather just stay home. Traveling is exciting, but it can be exhausting, too. The best part about a staycation is that I can do everything at my own pace. It's cheaper, there's no traffic, and nobody is rushing me. By the end of the vacation, I feel completely refreshed.
answers.AL: Honestly, I'm a bit of a homebody, so my ideal vacation isn't a beach resort or a packed itinerary. It's a week at home with absolutely nothing on my calendar. I usually kick things off by sleeping in until ten, which is a luxury I never get on weekdays. Then I make a proper breakfast, grind some coffee beans, and take my time with a cup on the balcony. From there, I just look out at the river and let my mind wander. The rest of the day is pretty unstructured. I might binge a drama I've been meaning to watch, try a new recipe, or finally tackle something I've been putting off, like reorganizing the closet. Some evenings a couple of friends come over, we order chicken, and we end up talking until midnight. It's not that I don't like traveling; it's just that home is where I truly unwind. When I travel, I tend to overplan and come back more tired than when I left. At home, there's no traffic, no crowds, and no checkout time. Nobody is rushing me anywhere. By the end of the week, I feel like I've actually rested, and that's exactly what a vacation is supposed to do.

questions.en: Tell me about a typical day when you are on vacation at home. What do you do from morning to night, and who do you spend the time with?
questions.ko: 집에서 휴가를 보내는 전형적인 하루에 대해 말해 주세요. 아침부터 밤까지 무엇을 하고, 누구와 시간을 보내나요?
tips: 시간 순서: In the morning → In the afternoon → In the evening → Before bed
'sleep in', 'catch up on', 'come over' 같은 구동사 활용

answers.IM3: On a vacation day, I get up late, around ten. I make coffee and eat a simple breakfast. In the morning, I usually watch YouTube or read a book on the sofa. In the afternoon, I go to a cafe near my apartment or take a walk by the river. In the evening, my friend sometimes comes over. We cook dinner together or order chicken. Then we watch a movie. I go to bed around midnight. It's a slow and relaxing day.
answers.IH: Well, a vacation day at home is very different from a workday. I sleep in until about ten, which feels amazing. Then I make coffee, eat a late breakfast, and just sit on the balcony for a while. In the morning, I usually read or watch YouTube on the sofa. Around lunchtime, I walk to a cafe near my apartment and have a sandwich. In the afternoon, I do something small around the house, like laundry or watering the plants. Some days I take a walk along the river. In the evening, my best friend often comes over. We cook dinner together, or if we're lazy, we just order chicken. After that, we watch a movie and talk until late. I usually spend the day alone, but I like having someone over in the evening. It's a slow day, but that's exactly why I love it.
answers.AL: A vacation day at home looks nothing like my normal routine, and that's the whole point. Instead of my seven o'clock alarm, I wake up naturally around ten, and the first thing I do is make a proper cup of coffee. I'll take it out to the balcony and just sit there for a while, watching the river and doing absolutely nothing. Late morning is usually for reading or catching up on a series I've fallen behind on. Around noon, I'll wander over to a cafe in my neighborhood, grab a sandwich, and maybe read a bit more. Afternoons are when I get small things done, like laundry, watering the plants, or finally going through that pile of mail. If the weather's nice, I'll take a long walk along the river. Evenings are the social part of the day. My best friend lives a few stops away, so she often comes over. We either cook something together or, more often than not, just order chicken and put on a movie. We end up chatting until well past midnight. So most of the day is just me, but having someone over at night keeps it from feeling lonely. It's a slow, quiet rhythm, and it's honestly my favorite kind of day.

questions.en: Tell me about a memorable vacation you spent at home. What did you do, and did anyone visit you? Why was it memorable?
questions.ko: 집에서 보낸 기억에 남는 휴가에 대해 말해 주세요. 무엇을 했고, 누가 찾아왔나요? 왜 기억에 남나요?
tips: 언제 → 무엇을 했나 → 누가 왔나 → 특별했던 일 → 느낌 (과거시제)
'came over', 'ended up ~ing' 같은 과거 표현으로 사건을 이어가세요

answers.IM3: Last summer, I took a week off and stayed home. It was very hot, so I didn't want to go outside. I watched a lot of movies and slept a lot. On Saturday, my two best friends came over. We cooked pasta together and ate on the balcony. Then we played board games until 2 a.m. It was so much fun. I felt very happy and relaxed. It was my best vacation in a long time.
answers.IH: The one I remember most was last summer. I took a week off in August, but it was so hot that I decided to just stay home. For the first few days, I did nothing but sleep, watch movies, and drink iced coffee. On Saturday, my two best friends came over for dinner. We cooked pasta together, which was a bit of a disaster because we burned the garlic, but it still tasted okay. After dinner, we sat on the balcony and ate watermelon while looking at the river. Then we played board games until two in the morning. I hadn't laughed that much in months. Actually, that night felt better than any trip I had taken. When I went back to work, I felt completely refreshed. It was a simple vacation, but it's still one of my favorites.
answers.AL: The one that stands out was last August. I had a week off, and I'd originally planned to go to Busan, but the heat wave was brutal, so I canceled everything and decided to hole up at home instead. The first three days were pure laziness. I slept until noon, worked my way through a whole drama series, and basically lived on iced coffee. Then on Saturday, my two closest friends came over for dinner. We attempted to make pasta from scratch, which turned into a bit of a mess because we burned the garlic and set off the smoke alarm. We ended up laughing so hard we could barely finish cooking. After dinner, we carried a watermelon out to the balcony and sat there watching the city lights. At some point, someone pulled out a board game, and before we knew it, it was two in the morning. I hadn't laughed like that in months. What made it memorable wasn't anything fancy. It was just having the people I care about in my own space with no schedule to follow. When I went back to work, I felt more refreshed than after any actual trip I'd taken. That week really changed how I think about vacations.

questions.en: Some people like to travel during their vacations, while others prefer to stay home. What are the advantages and disadvantages of each? Which do you prefer and why?
questions.ko: 휴가 때 여행을 가는 사람도 있고 집에 머무는 걸 선호하는 사람도 있죠. 각각의 장단점은 무엇인가요? 당신은 어느 쪽을 선호하고 그 이유는요?
tips: 집 장점 2개 → 여행 장점 2개 → 내 선택 + 이유
'On the other hand', 'The downside is that ~' 로 대조하세요

answers.IM3: Staying home is cheap and relaxing. I can sleep late and do what I want. But sometimes it can be a little boring. Traveling is exciting because I can see new places and eat new food. But it costs a lot of money, and I get tired from the long trip. I prefer staying home because I want to rest. I have a busy job, so I need quiet time. Maybe I will travel once a year, but for short vacations, home is better.
answers.IH: Well, both have their good and bad points. Staying home is cheap and relaxing. I can sleep in, eat what I want, and follow my own schedule. The downside is that it can get a bit boring, and I sometimes feel like I wasted my vacation. Traveling, on the other hand, is exciting. You see new places, try new food, and make memories. But it costs a lot, and to be honest, it can be exhausting. When I come back from a trip, I often feel like I need another vacation. I used to travel every summer, but these days I'd rather stay home. My job is busy, so what I really need is quiet time to recharge. I still try to take one trip a year, but for shorter breaks, home wins every time.
answers.AL: That's a good question, and honestly, I've gone back and forth on this over the years. Traveling has obvious advantages. You get out of your bubble, see something new, try food you'd never cook at home, and come back with stories to tell. The problem is that it's expensive, and if you're not careful, it can be more tiring than work. I've had trips where I came home needing a vacation from my vacation. Staying home, on the other hand, is cheap, low-stress, and completely under my control. I can sleep in, wander over to a cafe, and spend the afternoon reading without checking a map or a train schedule. The downside is that it can feel a little unproductive. There's always the risk that a week at home turns into a week of scrolling on my phone. Personally, I lean toward staying home these days. My job keeps me busy, so what I crave on vacation is quiet, not stimulation. I still try to take one real trip a year to shake things up. But for shorter breaks, nothing beats my own sofa and a good cup of coffee.

pronunciation.tip: '케이'에 강세. 첫소리는 ㅂ이 아니라 v(윗니로 아랫입술)
뒤 음절 강세 '릴랙스'. r은 혀가 입천장에 닿지 않게
v 발음 주의. '무비'의 ㅂ이 아니라 윗니로 아랫입술 살짝 물기
